extracted.name: Chicken Salad with Grapes and Apples
extracted.description: This chicken salad recipe includes grapes, apples, and red onion, creating a fruity and savory sandwich filling.
instruction_lines: Mix together chicken, grapes, apple, onion, mayonnaise, honey mustard, garlic powder, and black pepper in a bowl until well combined. Store in the refrigerator until serving.
